summary: Detailed architecture and roadmap for the Bare-Metal WASM + WebGPU Neuromorphic Crossbar Engine on Apple M4 Unified Memory, scaling up to 25M–100M memristors via Compressed Sparse Row (CSR) linear memory, WASM SIMD STDP synaptic ingestion, and WebGPU WGSL parallel crossbar resonance for fluent conversational synthesis.
